wholeGoal.title: Vielfalt und Artensterben
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Vielfalt von Arten benennen und auf Aussterben und Entdeckung neuer Arten eingehen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can name species diversity and address extinction and the discovery of new species.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 5.1 printed7–8. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Artenvielfalt, Entdeckung und Aussterben unterscheiden; lokale Beobachtung ist keine globale Vollinventur.
goals.scenePlanEn: Friendly meadow with four clearly different organisms and a fossil/field-guide inset. One new-to-science discovery clue and one extinct lineage symbol, no invented global count. Show species versus individuals without tiny tables.

wholeGoal.title: Gestalt und Merkmale
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Struktur und Funktion von Organen eines Säugetiers zuordnen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can assign structure and function to organs of a mammal.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 5.2 printed9–10. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Säugetierorgane anhand von Bau und Funktion zuordnen.
goals.scenePlanEn: Friendly dog silhouette with only three clear functional zooms: articulated forelimb for movement, lung for gas exchange, heart for transport. Correctly connected shapes, no giant full-organ chart.

wholeGoal.title: Angepasstheit an Lebensraum
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Merkmale eines Säugetiers als Anpassung an seinen Lebensraum deuten.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can interpret mammal characteristics as adaptations to their habitat.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 5.2 printed9–10. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Säugetiermerkmale als bewährte funktionelle Angepasstheiten erläutern, ohne zielgerichteten Erwerb.
goals.scenePlanEn: Otter beside water with dense fur waterproof-insulating zoom and webbed feet swimming zoom. Keep two main examples, no environmental command arrow creating a trait. Fur traps insulating air, never claim hair conducts sunlight into a bear.

wholeGoal.title: Ethogramm erstellen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Verhaltensweisen beobachten, in einem Ethogramm festhalten und deuten.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can observe behaviors, record them in an ethogram, and interpret them.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 5.2 printed9–10. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods. The goal requires genuine later observation and recording; synthetic model materials are not evidence that an actual observation has been performed.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Wirkliches Beobachten, trennscharfes Protokoll und vorsichtige Deutung eines Ethogramms.
goals.scenePlanEn: Student respectfully observing a calm dog, three timed posture sketches and writing a simple ethogram in a notebook facing the writer. No anthropomorphic dog thoughts or fake numeric experiment result.

wholeGoal.title: Evolution und Domestikation
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Entwicklungs- und Domestikationsaspekte eines Säugetiers beschreiben.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe developmental and domestication aspects of a mammal.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 5.2 printed9–10. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Gemeinsame Abstammung, vererbbare Variation und menschliche Zuchtauswahl unterscheiden.
goals.scenePlanEn: Small branching lineage from an ancestral wolf population to different domestic dog forms. Breeder selection shown by a neutral magnifying choice cue, no single modern wolf transforming into dog or ladder of progress.

wholeGoal.title: Keimung und Wachstum
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Keimungsbedingungen beschreiben und Wachstumsschritte verfolgen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe germination conditions and trace growth steps.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 5.4 printed12. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods. The goal requires genuine later observation and recording; synthetic model materials are not evidence that an actual observation has been performed.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Keimungsbedingungen und tatsächlich verfolgte Wachstumsschritte trennen.
goals.scenePlanEn: Four coherent bean germination stages with radicle emerging before green shoot, moist substrate, warmth and air icons. Notebook faces observing student. Light is a later growth resource, not universal germination prerequisite; no sealed submerged seed.

wholeGoal.title: Bau von Wurzel, Spross und Blatt
wholeGoal.titleEn: Root, Shoot, and Leaf Structure and Function
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Bau und Funktion von Wurzel, Spross und Blatt einer Blütenpflanze erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the structure and function of root, shoot, and leaf in a flowering plant.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 5.4 printed12. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Wurzel-, Spross- und Blattfunktionen als zusammenhängendes Transportsystem erklären.
goals.scenePlanEn: One friendly flowering plant with below-ground roots, stem and leaves. Large blue water/mineral arrow roots-to-leaves and different orange assimilate arrow from leaves toward sinks; sunlight enters leaves. No nutrient food absorbed from soil.

wholeGoal.title: Blütenaufbau und Funktion
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Blütenbestandteile benennen und ihre Funktion bei der Fortpflanzung erläutern.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can name flower parts and explain their function in reproduction.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 5.4 printed12. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Blütenbestandteile sowie Bestäubung, Befruchtung und Samenbildung funktionell verbinden.
goals.scenePlanEn: Clear stylized flower section with visible anther, stigma, style, ovary and ovule. Bee carries pollen to stigma; separate small seed/fruit continuation. Pollen cannot directly become the whole seed; bee never enters ovule.

wholeGoal.title: Wild- und Nutzpflanzen kennen lernen
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Wild- und Nutzpflanzen unterscheiden und einfache Bestimmungsmerkmale nutzen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can distinguish wild and useful plants and use simple identification features.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 5.4 printed12. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Wild-/Nutzpflanzen anhand von Nutzungskontext und einfachen Bestimmungsmerkmalen unterscheiden.
goals.scenePlanEn: Student with field guide observing wild daisy and cultivated bean plot. Magnified leaf and flower features support identification; no edible-food recommendation from appearance, no all wild plants harmful.

wholeGoal.title: Angepasstheit beschreiben
wholeGoal.titleEn: Vertebrate Adaptation as Structure and Function
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Bau- und Funktionsmerkmale als Anpassung an Lebensräume deuten.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can interpret structural and functional traits as adaptations to habitats.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 6.2 printed14. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods. 6.2 requires either bird or fish in depth; the unchosen class is only briefly compared. These own candidates preserve that curricular choice and claim no universal simultaneous depth.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Vogel- oder Fischmerkmale funktionell an Lebensräume binden; vertieftes Wahlthema kennzeichnen.
goals.scenePlanEn: Two main matched scenes: bird wing/feather in air and fish streamlined body/gills in water, each with one simple movement cue. Bird/fish is a curriculum choice, not simultaneous mandatory depth. No fins morphing into feathers.

wholeGoal.title: Fortpflanzungsstrategien
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Fortpflanzungsstrategien von Vögeln oder Fischen vergleichen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can compare reproductive strategies of birds or fish.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 6.2 printed14. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods. 6.2 requires either bird or fish in depth; the unchosen class is only briefly compared. These own candidates preserve that curricular choice and claim no universal simultaneous depth.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Revier, Balz, Paarung und unterschiedliche Investition in Nachkommen vergleichen.
goals.scenePlanEn: Side-by-side small bird nest with attentive parents and fish eggs in protected shallow habitat, only a few representative eggs plus subtle many cue. Both strategies have conditions; no all fishes abandon offspring or guaranteed survival.

wholeGoal.title: Leichtbau und Feder
wholeGoal.titleEn: Bird Lightweight Structure and Feather Function
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Leichtbauweise und Federfunktion von Vögeln erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain lightweight construction and feather function in birds.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 6.2 printed14 bird choice. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods. 6.2 requires either bird or fish in depth; the unchosen class is only briefly compared. These own candidates preserve that curricular choice and claim no universal simultaneous depth.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Leichtbau und Federbau funktionell für Flug und Isolation erklären, ohne alle Vögel flugfähig zu nennen.
goals.scenePlanEn: Flying bird with two large zooms: lightweight braced bone cross-section, coherent feather vane with barbs. Rounded comic form; correct feathers, no plastic solid feather or completely empty unsupported skeleton.

wholeGoal.title: Stromlinienform und Kiemen
wholeGoal.titleEn: Fish Streamlining, Gills, and Swim Bladder
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Stromlinienform, Kiemen und Schwimmblase von Fischen beschreiben.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe streamlining, gills, and swim bladder in fish.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 6.2 printed14 fish choice. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods. 6.2 requires either bird or fish in depth; the unchosen class is only briefly compared. These own candidates preserve that curricular choice and claim no universal simultaneous depth.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Stromlinienform, Kiemen und Gasraum-Auftrieb als getrennte Fischfunktionen erklären.
goals.scenePlanEn: One typical bony fish with clear body contour, water through mouth across red gills to operculum, and small separated internal swim-bladder gas sac. Gill gas exchange through water; no oxygen-air hose directly to bladder or every fish has a bladder.

wholeGoal.title: Entwicklung und Vergleich
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Reptilienentwicklung beschreiben und mit Vögeln vergleichen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe reptile development and compare it with birds.

goals.conceptAndOperator: Reptilienentwicklung mit Vogelentwicklung anhand amniotischer Gemeinsamkeiten und Unterschieden vergleichen.
goals.scenePlanEn: Two simple amniotic egg cross-sections for lizard and bird, with embryo/yolk/protective envelope. Small direct hatchling continuations: young lizard and chick; no tadpole larva or metamorphosis step in either.

wholeGoal.title: Körpertemperatur regulieren
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Strategien wechselwarmer Tiere zur Temperaturregulation beschreiben.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe strategies of ectothermic animals for temperature regulation.

goals.conceptAndOperator: Verhaltensregulation bei Ektothermen einschließlich Umwelt- und Aktivitätsgrenzen beschreiben.
goals.scenePlanEn: Same lizard choosing sunny rock then shaded shelter; one clear external heat arrow and small thermometer change. Ectothermic is not always cold and shade choice regulates within limits; no internal heater or blanket sleeping-in-cold message.

wholeGoal.title: Wärmesinnesorgan

wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain the heat-sensing organ, for example in a rattlesnake.

goals.conceptAndOperator: Infrarot-Wahrnehmung des Grubenorgans mit Sehorgan ergänzend verbinden.
goals.scenePlanEn: Gentle rattlesnake side head with correctly placed loreal pit between nostril and eye, large zoom and a warm mouse at a distance. Separate dotted thermal-signal cue from ordinary vision cue; no seeing blood or all snakes having identical pit organs.

wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Sauerstoffversorgung über Haut und Lunge bei Amphibien erklären.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain oxygen supply through skin and lungs in amphibians.

goals.conceptAndOperator: O2-Versorgung eines adulten Frosches über feuchte Haut und Lunge erklären.
goals.scenePlanEn: Friendly adult frog at pond edge. Blue incoming oxygen cues at moist skin and through mouth-to-lung path; separate outgoing carbon-dioxide cues. Correct frog mouth floor respiratory pump, no external gills on adult or dry waterproof skin.

wholeGoal.title: Metamorphose steuern
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann hormonelle Steuerung der Metamorphose beschreiben und Versuchsergebnisse deuten.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can describe hormonal control of metamorphosis and interpret experimental results.

goals.scenePlanEn: Tadpole-to-frog sequence with coherent limbs and gradually shortening tail, thyroid/hormone message cue beside a small labelled comparison. Schematic supplied result, no child administering hormones to live animals.

wholeGoal.title: Brutpflege und Fortpflanzung
wholeGoal.titleEn: Amphibian Brood Care and Egg Numbers
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Brutpflegeformen und Eizahlen von Amphibien vergleichen.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can compare forms of brood care and egg numbers in amphibians.

goals.sourceBoundary: HE G9 6.4 printed16. Actual whole section read; selected bounded goal, no approval of all surrounding methods.
goals.conceptAndOperator: Eizahlen und unterschiedliche Brutpflegeformen vergleichen, ohne pauschale Erfolgsregel.
goals.scenePlanEn: Amphibian contrast: larger water egg clutch with little care versus small carried/guarded clutch. No birds or mammalian nursing, no cross-species continuum claiming all large clutches survive less in every habitat.

wholeGoal.title: Artgerechte Haltung
wholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Anforderungen an artgerechte Haltung kennen und anwenden.
wholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can know and apply requirements for species-appropriate animal keeping.

goals.conceptAndOperator: Artgerechte Haltung mit Physiologie, Verhalten und Verantwortung auf konkrete Fälle anwenden.
goals.scenePlanEn: Student planning responsible rabbit care with companion rabbit, roomy secure enriched enclosure, hay/water and refuge. Calm respectful scene, not a decorative tiny cage; no animal pictured as toy or every species needing identical companions.
